lines.21: 「If we hadn't disagreed at the middle-school culture festival, we wouldn't have taken such a long detour.」
lines.23: Had all those harsh words been affection in disguise?
lines.24: 「...Hah. For someone named Sunao, you sure aren't very honest.」
lines.27: 「Besides, until we made up, it wasn't so much affection in disguise--my crest was genuinely standing on end!」
lines.28: 「I see... So you did like me.」
lines.29: 「Would you listen to what I'm saying!?」
lines.30: 「When I think of it that way, even your angry face is cute.」
lines.32: 「Y-you really do make my crest stand on end!」
lines.33: 「Ha. Still not living up to your name.」
lines.35: 「...If you like me and I like you, then there's no problem, right?」
lines.38: 「Oh, come on. It's not fair when you suddenly put on that serious face again...」
lines.43: Konoe reached out her hand too.
lines.44: We clasped each other's hands firmly.
lines.45: 「Your hand... it's so white and beautiful!」
lines.48: Somehow, we looked less like lovers and more like two guys sealing a friendship.
lines.49: --And so, after one long, long fight...
